name: Canaan
title: Ham's Cursed Son
summary: Canaan was the son of Ham and the grandson of Noah. He was cursed by Noah after his father Ham saw Noah's nakedness. Canaan's descendants became the Canaanite peoples who settled in the land that later became known as the Land of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Canaan
keyEvents.description: Canaan was born as the son of Ham, one of Noah's three sons, after the great flood.

keyEvents.title: Noah's curse on Canaan
keyEvents.description: After Ham saw his father Noah's nakedness and told his brothers, Noah cursed Canaan and declared that he would be the lowest slave to his brothers.

keyEvents.title: The blessing on Shem and Japheth
keyEvents.description: In contrast to the curse on Canaan, Noah blessed Shem and Japheth, declaring that Canaan would be their servant.

keyEvents.title: Canaan's descendants
keyEvents.description: Canaan's descendants included Sidon (his firstborn), Heth, the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites, the Hittites, and several other peoples who settled in the area known as the land of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: The borders of Canaan's land
keyEvents.description: The territory of Canaan's descendants stretched from Sidon toward Gerar to Gaza, and toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim to Lasha.

keyEvents.title: Canaan's people in God's judgment
keyEvents.description: The Canaanite peoples later became the object of God's judgment when the Israelites under Joshua conquered the promised land, as prophesied through Noah's curse.
